fr35_resolution.issue: FR-35 requires a read-only snapshot or Git blob for any compared file not part of commit 5f3f5d31. data/ and outputs/ are entirely gitignored by project convention (NFR-8), so every data input is structurally 'not part of any commit'.
fr35_resolution.user_decision_2026-08-12_round_1: Data files also require read-only snapshot/blob, not hash-only.
fr35_resolution.user_decision_2026-08-12_round_2: `git hash-object -w` blobs are unreferenced loose objects and can be pruned by `git gc` — not durable on their own. Actual read-only, non-hard-link file copies MUST be kept in a gitignored snapshot directory, with a manifest recording per-file hash, aggregate hash, file count, size, and rebuild/verify commands.
fr35_resolution.action_taken: Both mechanisms now exist: (1) git blobs from round 1, still present in .git/objects but explicitly documented as non-durable/secondary; (2) the authoritative durable record — genuine file copies (via `cp --no-preserve=links`, then chmod read-only) of all 979 data files (4 research parquet + 3 c2_fullpool CSVs + 972 Scores-cache parquet) under research/p0_r1_research_production_identity/data_snapshot/ (gitignored, ~82 MiB). Every copy was re-hashed and verified against the originally recorded sha256 — 0 mismatches. Full manifest: data_snapshot_manifest.json; per-file hash listing: data_snapshot_sha256sums.txt (979 lines, versionable, 154KB).
fr35_resolution.gate_r1_p_fr35_status: satisfied via the durable snapshot (data_snapshot_manifest.json), not the git blobs alone
